_comment: Hand-authored stub recording for the F10 RecordingBridge harness. Demonstrates the recording-file format so the parity tests can prove the playback adapter wires through ILacerteBridge end-to-end. One entry per (op, argsFingerprint) — the bridge replays the matching result when the session manager calls into it. NOTE: the session manager passes appId=string.Empty when no AppID is stored in Credential Manager (off-Windows / dev / CI), so the fixture pins appId to '' to match the actual chokepoint args.
